repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a cycle that repeats indefinitely (until is null). The candidate incorrectly includes an 'else' branch that executes the actions on every subsequent iteration, causing the Valve to close and Mail to be sent at t=60000ms. The IR only sends Mail at t=60000ms (the first cycle body) and never closes the Valve again.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the 'else' block entirely. The IR's 'cycle' with no 'until' condition implies infinite repetition. The candidate's 'else' block erroneously duplicated the actions for the cycle body on every iteration. Removing it allows the script to loop only on the initial body execution (after the wait), which matches the IR's infinite cycle of sending mail every minute.
